3-Bedroom Mission District Home with Garage & Bonus Space  Available now in the heart of San Francisco's Mission District This spacious two-level home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, a private garage, laundry, backyard, and a large flexible bonus space perfect for a home office, studio, recreation room, or storage.  Home Features  Second Floor Main Living Area  3 bedrooms  Fully equipped kitchen  1 full bathroom  Comfortable living space  Access to the backyard  First Floor Bonus & Utility Space  Large multipurpose/bonus room  1 full bathroom  Air conditioning in the bonus room  Washer and dryer  Private garage  Additional flexible space for a home office, studio, gym, recreation room, or storage   *Prime Mission District Location  Conveniently located near restaurants, cafes, shops, schools, public transportation, and all that the vibrant Mission District has to offer.   Pets are welcome. Tenant is responsible for all utilities and services.

Step into the timeless character of a classic San Francisco apartment with the comfort of thoughtful modern updates. Located at 1850 Sacramento Street, this beautifully updated home blends the architectural details people love about San Francisco with a fresh, inviting feel.

This spacious 3-bedroom, 1-bath residence combines memorable views, classic San Francisco character, and modern everyday conveniences. Tall ceilings, fresh paint, attractive light fixtures, and new flooring throughout create a bright, polished, move-in-ready feel.
The updated kitchen features premium stainless-steel appliances and offers a stylish setting for everyday cooking and entertaining. The view-facing living and dining areas, complemented by a fireplace, provide an exceptional backdrop for working from home, hosting friends, or unwinding as the light changes over the Bay.
Step outside to the private outdoor deck for morning coffee, sunset drinks, fresh air, or a quiet moment above the city. An in-unit washer and dryer adds the everyday convenience that is so hard to find in San Francisco.

3-bedroom, 1.5-bath single-family home in Bernal Heights, approximately 1,600 sq ft. Private backyard, one compact-car parking space in the garage with full garage access, and brand-new washer, dryer and dishwasher.
Main level includes living room, dining room, eat-in kitchen, one bedroom and full bath. Upstairs are two large bedrooms, including one with an en-suite half bath.
Conveniently located near Cortland Avenue's restaurants, shops and bars, as well as the Bernal Heights Library, Community Center and Rec Centers. Close to Bernal Heights Park. Convenient to the 24, 67, 14 and 49 Muni lines, 24th St BART, and 101/280. Managed by owner.

Family home available for sublet in sunny Bernal Heights while we are travelling. We are seeking subletters who will enjoy our home and take care of it. Perfect for families, individuals, and couples of all ages. Our house is filled with character, with expansive views of downtown and the city, and would be most enjoyed by artistic individuals who appreciate creative architecture. The main floor includes a beautiful kitchen and living room, multiple bedrooms, a bathroom, and office space. The downstairs levels include additional sleeping areas, bathrooms, and a spacious family room. We are located on a flat street with a wide sidewalk, accessible on foot to all amenities. Serious inquiries only.

2262 Filbert Street, San Francisco, CA 94123
Beautifully remodeled top-floor 5-room Victorian flat in the heart of Cow Hollow, one of San Francisco’s most desirable and walkable neighborhoods. The top-floor location provides excellent natural light, privacy, and a wonderful residential feel.
